feature_descriptions.RICE AREA (1000 ha): District rice cultivated area in thousand hectares
feature_descriptions.TOTAL_CROPPED_AREA: Total cultivated area across all crops in district
feature_descriptions.RICE_AREA_SHARE: Proportion of district cropland allocated to rice cultivation
feature_descriptions.WHEAT AREA (1000 ha): District wheat cropped area (Rabi cropping intensity indicator)
feature_descriptions.COTTON AREA (1000 ha): District cotton cropped area (cash crop competition indicator)
feature_descriptions.SUGARCANE AREA (1000 ha): District sugarcane cropped area (high irrigation access indicator)
feature_descriptions.RICE_YIELD_LAG1: Reported rice yield in previous agricultural year (t-1)
feature_descriptions.RICE_YIELD_ROLL3: 3-year historical rolling average rice yield up to t-1

excluded_leakage_features: All concurrent non-rice production variables (23 columns)
All concurrent non-rice yield variables (22 columns)
